messages:
tess: Follow-up from INC-2026-1120 postmortem. Pattern = recurring latency spikes during KV invalidation + sudden fanout. Need temporary SLO adjustments, owners, and clear rollback rules.
tess: My proposal: p95 latency SLO 140ms -> 210ms for 28 days. Re-evaluate at 72h and 14d. Rollback early if p95 < 170ms for 7 consecutive days.
anna (SRE): ok on numbers. Recommend we also change throughput SLO evaluation window 60s -> 30s while this is in effect so short bursts don't burn error budget.
ben: I'll take customer comms and SLA doc updates. Will prepare segmented notices (affected customers only) and hold until 72h unless user-facing regressions.
mira: I'll own dashboards + runbook. Will add p95/p99 panels by pool, QPS by pool, KV invalidation rate, and canary annotations. Sample PromQL for p99 by pool: ```histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool))```
followup-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-1120-FOLLOWUP (#4899) and linked postmortem. Owners: anna, ben, mira, tess.
ops-bot: Reminder: oncall this week = anna (SRE).
tess: Draft action items (please review/ack): - Dashboard & runbook (48h): mira - Canary autoscaler + batching knobs (start in 4d): anna - Customer comms draft (72h): ben - Error-budget policy addendum (auto-reset rules) (5d): tess - Quarterly recurrence detection job (monthly): anna
anna (SRE): ack. I'll run kernel perf probes and the canary. Canary abort if p99 > 450ms for 10m. Adding automated fallback: if p95 > 320ms for 10m, route to lower-capacity model until recovered.
mira: ack. Dashboard PR will include annotations and a 99p alarm. PR link: https://git.redwood/dashboard/pull/999 (stub).
ben: ack. Draft in Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=inc4899-comms (private). Will request legal review after we lock the temp window.
tess: Note on rollback criteria in SLO governance: need explicit metric, duration, and owner signoff. I'll patch and ping #all-hands once comms are sent.
anna (SRE): Also adding a recurring tag to the incident so we can detect patterns across quarters.
followup-bot: Incident follow-up checklist updated in #4899.
ops-bot: Next SRE rotation reminder set for 2501680000.
tess: Please drop a one-line "owned" when you've linked PRs/tickets so I can finalize owners in the follow-up ticket.
anna (SRE): owned (canary plan linked).
mira: owned (dashboard PR linked).
ben: owned (comms draft linked).
tess: Thanks all 44d We'll reassess at 72h and at 14d; if anyone needs to swap ownership update ticket or ping me directly.
